entries.zh:
rest_command:
  line_push:
    url: "https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push"
    method: post
    content_type: "application/json"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer 你的_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN"
    payload: >-
      {"to": "你的_USER_ID",
       "messages": [{"type": "text", "text": "{{ msg }}"}]}
entries.en:
rest_command:
  line_push:
    url: "https://api.line.me/v2/bot/message/push"
    method: post
    content_type: "application/json"
    headers:
      Authorization: "Bearer your_CHANNEL_ACCESS_TOKEN"
    payload: >-
      {"to": "your_USER_ID",
       "messages": [{"type": "text", "text": "{{ msg }}"}]}

entries.zh:
actions:
  - action: rest_command.line_push
    data:
      msg: "洗衣機洗好了，記得去晾"
entries.en:
actions:
  - action: rest_command.line_push
    data:
      msg: "The washing machine has finished washing, remember to dry it"
